note: Commands Claude pushes for the Studio plugin to run. Each runs once, identified by id. The plugin prints every command before running it, and only runs them at all while 'Allow commands' is switched on.

commands.label: Say hello and report what is in this place
commands.luau:
-- First command across the bridge. Reads only; changes nothing.
return function()
	local sss = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local rs  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local sp  = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
	local function count(root)
		if not root then return 0 end
		local n = 0
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then n = n + 1 end
		end
		return n
	end
	local server = sss:FindFirstChild("Server")
	local shared = rs:FindFirstChild("Shared")
	local sps    = sp:FindFirstChild("StarterPlayerScripts")
	local client = sps and sps:FindFirstChild("Client")
	local parts = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts = parts + 1 end
	end
	print("=======================================")
	print("  Claude is connected to this place.")
	print("  Server scripts : " .. count(server))
	print("  Shared scripts : " .. count(shared))
	print("  Client scripts : " .. count(client))
	print("  Parts in Workspace: " .. parts)
	print("  Nothing was changed by this command.")
	print("=======================================")
	return true
end
